> **These pages describe `main`, not the last release.** They are generated
> from the SDK sources in this repository, so they can document a surface a
> published package does not have yet; [`CHANGELOG.md`](/docs/changelog/) says what is still
> unreleased. For the reference that matches what you installed, read the
> `.d.ts` in your own `node_modules/@sakaladev/usai`.


## Modules

| Module | Description |
| ------ | ------ |
| [config](/docs/sdk/config/) | `@sakaladev/usai/config` — the shape of `usai.config.ts`: project structure only (entry, output directory, migration and seeder globs), declarative. Start with [defineConfig](/docs/sdk/config/functions/defineconfig/). |
| [index](/docs/sdk/index/) | `@sakaladev/usai` — declare work and resources; the runtime gives each its natural lifetime. Public surface for v0 (breaking changes allowed before alpha). Start with [defineApp](/docs/sdk/index/functions/defineapp/), then [http](/docs/sdk/index/variables/http/), [task](/docs/sdk/index/functions/task/), [cron](/docs/sdk/index/functions/cron/), [queue](/docs/sdk/index/variables/queue/), [postgres](/docs/sdk/index/functions/postgres/); every handler receives a [BaseContext](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/basecontext/). What *your* application declares — every operation, what it leases and hands off, a request panel — is the application reference at `/_usai/docs` on a running `usai dev`. |
| [test](/docs/sdk/test/) | `@sakaladev/usai/test` — run the same application model tests will meet in production. The harness spawns the `usai` runtime for the project, talks HTTP to the application, and invokes tasks, cron ticks and commands deterministically through the control surface: no wall clock, no external server. Start with [testApp](/docs/sdk/test/functions/testapp/). |
